---
name: Security report notice
about: Do not file public security reports here.
title: "[Security]: use private disclosure"
labels: security
---

Do not file public security reports in GitHub issues.

Email security@vaultage.dev with impact, affected version or commit,
reproduction steps, and whether any real secret material is involved.

Do not include real secrets, vault files, provider tokens, `.env` contents, exploit screenshots containing secret values, or private logs.
